description.value:
When this staff is prepared, the carved wooden animal figurine atop it shifts to resemble the owner's familiar. While wielding this staff, you can communicate telepathically with your familiar, even if it doesn't normally understand or speak a language, with a range of 30 feet.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Protect Companion]

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Pet Cache]

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Floating Harness]

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Familiar's Call], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Tiny Wings]

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Defensive Prescience], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Overload Connection]

  • 5th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Familiar's Call], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Sudden Swarm]

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
